world.title: Two Connecticut homeowners went to court in 2019 over a utility pole that prevented them from widening their driveway; seven years later, an appeals court upheld an order requiring neighbours to autho
world.summary: Two homeowners in Easton, Connecticut, faced a legal dispute since 2019 over a utility pole obstructing their driveway expansion. After seven years, an appeals court upheld an order requiring the neighbors to authorize the pole's removal. The case highlights ongoing tensions between the homeowners and utility companies regarding property rights and infrastructure placement in residential areas.

world.title: Fresh escalation soon? Israel says may strike Iran 'at any moment', even without US
world.summary: Israel's military spokesman Effie Defrin announced that the country is prepared to conduct strikes on Iran "at any moment," potentially without U.S. support. This statement reflects caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's increasing impatience following recent elections. The Israeli military is actively monitoring the situation, indicating a readiness to respond with force if necessary.

world.title: Quote of the Day by Benjamin Franklin, " “Beer is proof that God loves us and wants us to be ...."
world.summary: Benjamin Franklin, a prominent American figure, is celebrated for his diverse contributions as a writer, philosopher, scientist, inventor, diplomat, publisher, and political thinker. His famous quote, “Beer is proof that God loves us and wants us to be happy,” reflects his wit and perspective on life. Franklin's legacy continues to influence various fields and American culture.

business.title: IBM Gives H-1B Visa and Green Card Holders 3 Weeks to Relocate or Quit
business.summary: IBM has announced that employees holding H-1B visas and green cards in its Consulting division must relocate or resign within three weeks. Those opting to leave will receive three months' severance pay, with December 31 designated as their final working day. This decision affects a significant portion of IBM Consulting, which employs over 150,000 individuals.

business.title: Gold Price Forecast: Lower Yields Fuel Rebound Despite Fed Hike Bets
business.summary: Gold prices have rebounded from the support zone of $3,400-$3,500, aided by a correction in the US dollar and Treasury yields. However, ongoing inflation and economic data from the US continue to sustain high expectations for interest rate hikes, which may restrict further recovery. Buyers are now looking for a breakthrough above the $3,700 level.

business.title: Supreme Court sets four-month deadline for FSSAI to finalise stricter food labelling norms
business.summary: The Supreme Court of India has set a four-month deadline for the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) to finalize stricter food labeling norms. The court mandated the use of standardized FoPNL hexagons to highlight total sugars, saturated fat, and salt as nutrients of concern, emphasizing the state's obligation to protect public health through regulation.

technology.title: Claude users can now build their own Mac and Windows apps without writing code
technology.summary: Anthropic has introduced a new feature allowing Claude users to create desktop applications for Mac and Windows without any coding. The "Install as app" functionality is currently in beta and available across all Claude plans, including the free tier. This development aims to simplify the app creation process, enabling users to transform their artifacts into fully functional desktop applications.

technology.title: Upcoming Smartphones in December 2026 India: Full List
technology.summary: India's smartphone market is set for significant launches in December 2026, featuring the Motorola Signature 27 on December 9, Xiaomi 18 Pro, and OPPO Reno 17 series. Additionally, the Edge 70 Neo will be available from December 1. These devices are expected to include advanced technology such as 2nm flagship silicon and high-capacity batteries ranging from 7,000mAh to 8,000mAh.

sports.title: 'Sooryavanshi will score 500 in a Test': Kevin Pietersen's jaw-dropping prediction for India's 15-year-old sensation
sports.summary: Former England captain Kevin Pietersen has made a bold prediction regarding 15-year-old Indian cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, stating he will score 500 runs in a Test match. Sooryavanshi's rapid ascent in cricket has garnered attention from prominent figures in the sport. His performances continue to impress, leading to high expectations for his future in international cricket.

sports.title: South Africa’s kids will be alright
sports.summary: Jack Ackerman has emerged as a notable figure in South African cricket, drawing attention for his supportive presence during Marques' impressive 150 against Bangladesh in Centurion. Previously, Leo Paterson was a prominent young talent, expressing curiosity about cricketing skills. The article highlights the excitement surrounding young cricketers in South Africa and their potential contributions to the sport's future.

sports.title: Daniel King analyses: London System in Game 2
sports.summary: In Game 2 of the World Championship match, defending champion Gukesh faced challenger Javokhir Sindarov, featuring the London System. Daniel King provided a video analysis highlighting key moments from the game. The analysis is part of ChessBase 18, which offers enhanced training and analysis tools, including playing style assessments and access to a vast database of Lichess games.

health.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak tops 12,000 cases amid fighting
health.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported 12,021 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,904 deaths amid ongoing conflict in the eastern region. This outbreak is noted as the fastest-growing in history, according to the Associated Press. The situation remains critical as health officials work to manage the crisis while addressing the challenges posed by the violence.

health.title: Diabetes Management: 5 Tests You Shouldn't Ignore
health.summary: Dr. Ankita Verma from Rama Hospital emphasizes the importance of five key tests for diabetes management. These tests are crucial for individuals at risk or already diagnosed with diabetes. The World Health Organization highlights that a significant portion of the population may be affected by diabetes. Regular testing can aid in effective health management and improve overall well-being.

health.title: Elevated blood sugar during adulthood linked with worse cognition in midlife: Study
health.summary: A new study indicates that young adults with rising fasting blood sugar levels are at a higher risk of experiencing poor cognitive functioning by midlife. Tracking participants over three decades, the research suggests that alterations in glucose metabolism may impact brain health earlier in adulthood than previously recognized. This highlights the potential long-term effects of elevated blood sugar on cognition.

science.title: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk watches the birth of daughter Katherine Grace from the International Space Station; her name honours the capsule that carried him to orbit
science.summary: Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk witnessed the birth of his daughter, Katherine Grace, from the International Space Station on November 24, 2026. His wife, Heather, gave birth to their third child in Houston. The name Katherine Grace honors the capsule that transported Kutryk to orbit, marking a significant moment for the family as they celebrated this milestone from space.

science.title: From 38,500 miles away, a NASA spacecraft photographed this final glimpse of our home planet before embarking on a 10-month Martian voyage, never to return
science.summary: NASA's ESCAPADE Gold spacecraft captured a final image of Earth from 38,500 miles away before starting its 10-month journey to Mars. The spacecraft utilized Earth's gravity for a slingshot maneuver, enabling it to head towards the Red Planet. Once it arrives, ESCAPADE Gold will study Mars' atmosphere, marking the beginning of its scientific mission.

science.title: Low overlap between bacterial and viral communities in meltwater and sediments of ice rise cryoconites
science.summary: Research on cryoconite microbial communities at Ward Hunt Ice Rise reveals low overlap between bacterial and viral populations in meltwater and sediments. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing showed that sediment hosts diverse bacteria, while meltwater is richer in eukaryotes. Bacteriophages dominate sediments, whereas giant viruses are prevalent in meltwater. This study establishes a baseline for understanding microbial interactions in these environments.

entertainment.title: O.M Operation Mole Box Office Collection Day 7
entertainment.summary: On Day 7, "O.M Operation Mole" collected ₹2.28 crore, bringing its total net earnings in India to ₹67.83 crore. The film is currently screening across 4,366 shows, with Day 7 earnings comprising ₹1.36 crore from Tamil, ₹77 lakh from Telugu, and ₹15 lakh from Hindi. The film's performance continues to be monitored closely.

entertainment.title: 'Rigged Big Time!': Miss Universe 2026 Winner Jennifer Barreto Faces Backlash, Internet Says 'Philippines Was Better'
entertainment.summary: Puerto Rico's Jennifer Barreto was crowned Miss Universe 2026, but her victory has faced significant backlash online, with many claiming the competition was biased. Critics argue that the Philippines had a stronger contestant, leading to accusations of unfairness in the judging process. The controversy has ignited discussions about the integrity of the pageant and the selection criteria used.

entertainment.title: Kangana Ranaut's Vibrant Gharara Suit Is The Ultimate Bridesmaid Fashion Inspiration
entertainment.summary: Kangana Ranaut showcased a stunning gharara suit at her friend Amit Tuli's wedding, providing bridesmaid fashion inspiration. The embroidered outfit featured a contrasting emerald green dupatta, highlighting a blend of traditional elegance and contemporary style. Ranaut's appearance at the event emphasized her fashion sense, making her a notable figure in ethnic wear for special occasions.
